SDBC Saturday Ride

San Diego, CA · La Jolla / University City · Road

Beginner friendly

SDBC Saturday Ride is a road group ride in San Diego, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from UC Cyclery. About 24–46 miles, 7 groups: A, B, C, and Development D-1 through D-4.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 7 groups: A, B, C, and Development D-1 through D-4. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @sandiegobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SDBC Saturday Ride group ride

Seven groups roll every Saturday from UC Cyclery, rain or shine, fastest first. First-timers fill out a form, come to the 8:15 orientation and start with a Development group. The D-4 ride is 24 miles and allows pedal-assist e-bikes. Open to the public.
